title: Palindrome Permutation II
description: Find all distinct palindromic permutations of a given string.
pseudocode:
1. count frequencies of characters
2. check if more than one odd frequency exists
3. build half string from characters with count/2
4. generate permutations of half string
5. mirror each permutation with middle char

steps.note: Check odd counts: Only 0 odd frequencies found, possible to form palindrome
